run_excitation_backprop: run excitation backprop on a model to compute saliency maps for a given category
run_contrastive_excitation_backprop: run contrastive excitation backprop to compute saliency by contrasting target class against others
use_excitation_backprop_context: use ExcitationBackpropContext to patch conv and pool layers with custom backward rules
run_eltwise_sum: run element-wise sum on multiple tensors to implement skip connections in ResNet models
run_update_resnet: run update_resnet to replace skip connections with EltwiseSum modules for excitation backprop
